name: Lu Lun
bio: Lu Lun (盧綸) was a poet of the T’ang dynasty in the later eighth century, counted among the “Ten Talents of the Dali era” (大曆十才子). He is best remembered for his frontier songs, among them the four “Songs of the Border” in this selection.
The poems here are the originals in Chinese, as selected by Sun Zhu for the Three Hundred Tang Poems (唐詩三百首, 1763).

poems.title: 李端公 (Li duan gong)
poems.author: Lu Lun
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.note: 五言律詩. Also titled 送李端.
poems.text:
故關衰草遍，離別自堪悲。
路出寒雲外，人歸暮雪時。
少孤爲客早，多難識君遲。
掩淚空相向，風塵何處期。

poems.title: 晚次鄂州 (Wan ci e zhou)
poems.author: Lu Lun
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
雲開遠見漢陽城，猶是孤帆一日程。
估客晝眠知浪靜，舟人夜語覺潮生。
三湘愁鬢逢秋色，萬里歸心對月明。
舊業已隨征戰盡，更堪江上鼓鼙聲。

poems.title: 和張僕射塞下曲·其一 (He zhang pu she sai xia qu, qi yi)
poems.author: Lu Lun
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
鷲翎金僕姑，燕尾繡蝥弧。
獨立揚新令，千營共一呼。

poems.title: 和張僕射塞下曲·其二 (He zhang pu she sai xia qu, qi er)
poems.author: Lu Lun
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
林暗草驚風，將軍夜引弓。
平明尋白羽，沒在石棱中。

poems.title: 和張僕射塞下曲·其三 (He zhang pu she sai xia qu, qi san)
poems.author: Lu Lun
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
月黑雁飛高，單于夜遁逃。
欲將輕騎逐，大雪滿弓刀。

poems.title: 和張僕射塞下曲·其四 (He zhang pu she sai xia qu, qi si)
poems.author: Lu Lun
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
野幕敞瓊筵，羌戎賀勞旋。
醉和金甲舞，雷鼓動山川。
